purpose: Review whether delivered domain governance packs are usable as advisory, source-backed guidance before adding more packs, scanners, policy engines or enforcement.

observed_strengths: Separates content trust from instruction authority.
Keeps external, retrieved, monitored and tool-returned content as evidence/context by default.
Connects pack guidance to checklist, template and synthetic review example.

observed_gaps.gap: No repeated real usage record yet.
observed_gaps.action: Use in at least one future reviewed Work Slice before adding automation or additional pack surface.

observed_gaps.gap: No enforcement failure mode observed yet.
observed_gaps.action: Keep scanners and policy engines deferred.

observed_strengths: Defines clear public-client versus authoritative-layer boundary.
Preserves unavailable fields instead of assuming security posture.
Connects pack guidance to checklist, template and synthetic review example.

observed_gaps.gap: No repeated real usage record yet.
observed_gaps.action: Use in at least one future reviewed web/API Work Slice before expanding domain-pack coverage.

observed_gaps.gap: No project-specific control mapping is proven reusable yet.
observed_gaps.action: Keep project-local controls out of framework truth until repeated cross-project need appears.

usage_decision.next_candidate: Use S28/S29 packs in future applicable Work Slices and record usage evidence.
usage_decision.rationale: The packs are coherent enough to guide manual review, but not mature enough to justify enforcement, scanners, dashboards, automatic classification or additional domain-pack proliferation.

recommended_next_signals.meaning: A reviewer applies S28 or S29 to an actual task and records source refs, finding posture and unavailable fields.
The same ambiguity blocks closure in more than one reviewed usage case.
A project-local control appears useful outside one project vocabulary.

new_domain_pack.reason: Adding more packs before usage evidence risks catalog growth without adoption proof.

domain_pack_enforcement.reason: No repeated manual failure mode proves that executable enforcement is needed.

scanner_or_policy_engine.reason: Current packs are advisory guidance; technical enforcement remains outside scope.

automatic_classification.reason: No validated classifier contract, training data or human review threshold exists.
